overview.title: جهة السلطة القديمة في المدينة
overview.p1: يستحضر حي القصبة دور تارودانت كمركز إقليمي. اليوم تجد شوارع أهدأ ومقاطع أسوار وإيقاعاً أقل تجارياً من أسراك.
overview.p2: يُجمع طبيعياً مع باب القصبة ومقطع من الأسوار. توقّع أجواء ومعماراً أكثر من متحف حصن بتذكرة.

food.title: الأكل في المنطقة
food.p1: Fewer restaurants than around Assarag. Plan meals toward the square or your hotel.
food.p2: The quarter is for walking, not dining density.
food.li5: Do not expect a restaurant strip.

1.title: Expectations
1.desc: Atmosphere and walls more than a single monument with tickets.

2.title: Combine
2.desc: Bab El Kasbah + ramparts segment + return via medina.

3.title: Respect
3.desc: Residential streets — keep noise down and ask before photos.

q1.question: Is there a kasbah museum?
q1.answer: Not a major ticketed complex like some cities; focus on streets and walls.

q2.question: Far from Assarag?
q2.answer: Walkable for most visitors; take a taxi if it is very hot.

q3.question: Worth it on a short stay?
q3.answer: Yes if you already walk the walls — adds depth beyond the square.

q4.question: Guide needed?
q4.answer: Optional for history; not required for a stroll.

q5.question: Best photo spot?
q5.answer: Near Bab El Kasbah and outer wall views at golden hour.
